text:
Jordan Chen: hi team — unpacking my new kit and everything arrived except the USB-C -> Ethernet dongle. monitor, keyboard, mouse arrived fine. any idea if that ships separately?
IT Help: hey Jordan — sorry about that. can you share the packing slip or the tracking number from the shipping email? sometimes adapters are in a small envelope.
Jordan Chen: tracking is `TRK-347829104-US`. packing slip photo: attached (pic of box, shows accessories list but no dongle).
IT Help: thanks. i've opened a ticket: INC-91234. putting logistics on it and I'll follow up with the shipper. ETA for a replacement depends on stock but we can overnight if needed.
OpsBot: Ticket INC-91234 created and assigned to IT Logistics. Status: open.
Linda P: welcome Jordan! :wave: if you're coming to the SF office this week I can bring a spare adapter — saves waiting on shipping.
Jordan Chen: appreciate it, Linda. planning to be in on Thurs. if the ticket will take longer, i'll swing by.
IT Help: quick workaround if you need wired right away: you can share Wi-Fi via laptop (Mac: System Preferences > Sharing > Internet Sharing) or we can enable a temporary VPN L2TP profile. which would you prefer?
Jordan Chen: could you enable the VPN? Remote setup is easier for me.
IT Help: sure — can you DM me your laptop serial and preferred username? I'll provision creds and post secure link.
Jordan Chen: sent serial in DM. thanks.
Matthew R: FYI — stock check shows 3 adapters in SF cupboards, 1 reserved for QA. IT Logistics said they can drop one at reception by 3pm tomorrow if needed.
IT Help: update: shipper confirmed the adapter was a separate parcel — expected delivery tomorrow. i've left the overnight option on the ticket, but since SF has a spare we can use that first.
Jordan Chen: great, i'll pick it up Thurs morning if it's there. thanks everyone! :thumbsup:
OpsBot: Ticket INC-91234 status updated: awaiting pickup at SF reception.
IT Help: marking as resolved in Slack thread, ticket will be closed after pickup confirmation.
Jordan Chen: confirmed pickup on Thu at 9:12am — adapter working. closing the loop, thanks all. :white_check_mark:
